standard_prerequisites.name: The zeroth K-group of a ring equals the zeroth K-group of its perfect derived category, by the More on Algebra universal property lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the module-level description of K_0(R).

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme perfect objects correspond to perfect complexes of modules and the derived categories compare, by the perfect affine and affine comparison lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies D_perf(R) with D_perf(O_X), giving K_0(R) = K_0(X).

standard_prerequisites.name: Over a Noetherian ring the coherent sheaves on the affine scheme are the finite modules, by the cohomology coherent Noetherian lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives K'_0(R) = K'_0(X) from the definitions.

core_obligations: Recall the definitions of K'_0(R) and K_0(R) from the algebra K-groups section (proof lines 10141-10142).
K_0 part: the universal property lemma gives K_0(R) = K_0(D_perf(R)); the perfect-affine and affine-comparison lemmas give D_perf(R) = D_perf(O_X); conclude K_0(R) = K_0(X) (proof lines 10143-10148).

K'_0 part: over a Noetherian ring the category of coherent sheaves on X is equivalent to finite R-modules by the coherent Noetherian lemma, and K'_0(R) is by definition the Grothendieck group of finite R-modules; conclude K'_0(R) = K'_0(X) (proof lines 10150-10157).
proof_roadmap: Identify K_0(R) with K_0 of the perfect derived category and transport through the affine equivalences (proof lines 10143-10148).
Identify K'_0 through the equivalence of coherent sheaves with finite modules (proof lines 10150-10157).
